g2-implement.title: Pilot pipeline orchestrator + CLI + tests: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for this gate and dispatch a constellation-implementer via run_crew.py. Build a THIN orchestrator (lowest-dimensionality — wire existing stages, build NO new model): a new package src/physics/pilot/ (pipeline.py) + a CLI scripts/run_pilot_669.py that, per circuit, invokes the 6 landed stages in order — C derive+validate (segment map), D grip fit + held-out/synthetic gating, E build observables + jackknife/positive-control gating (this chains C live + optional D), G fingerprint smoke fit, H join + t7 invariants, PANEL dry-run — collecting each stage's C/D/E/H GATING verdict (pass/fail + numbers) into a per-circuit + summary result JSON, writing ALL run artifacts to ISOLATED own-DB/scratch paths (never data/f1_data_*.db), OFFLINE ONLY, RESUMABLE (idempotent skip of completed circuits). CRITIC-HARDENING (binding): (1) [critic #5/#7] invoke each HEAVY stage as a subprocess with an EXPLICIT per-stage wall-time budget (seeded from the g1 estimate + margin) so a hang AUTO-PARKS the stage and triggers the archived-fp_slice_2023Q.db fallback — do NOT rely on a human poll to detect a hang; attempt FRESH once per circuit before falling back, and stamp per-circuit PROVENANCE (fresh|fell-back + reason) in the results JSON; (2) [critic #4] per circuit, assert CONSISTENCY between C's persisted segment_maps.db map and E's live-re-derived map (segment count / boundary signature) and record any divergence as a flagged finding (do NOT unify the paths); (3) [critic #8] gating-collection must assert NON-EMPTY/FINITE outputs (observables rows>0, fingerprint params finite, join prior non-null) — a stage that ran without raising but produced N=0/null is a FAIL, not a vacuous pass; (4) [critic #9] the results schema must name grip-G (D stage, held-out score) distinctly from the fingerprint stage (G/#666). Emit the per-circuit results JSON to .agent-work/669-pilot/artifacts/pilot_results.json + a short human report to docs/physics/pilot_669_report.md. Also ship scripts/verify_pilot_results_669.py — a small structural verifier (used by g3's mechanical check) that loads the results JSON and asserts all 3 circuits are present, each carrying the 6 output slots + a C/D/E/H pass/fail verdict + fresh|fell-back provenance (exit non-zero on any missing). Add unit tests under tests/unit/physics/pilot/ exercising the wiring + gating-collection + the fallback/timeout branch + the map-consistency check + the non-empty assertions (fixture/one-circuit scope). CLOSE CRITERION [critic #1]: demonstrate the orchestrator runs the FULL C→D→E→G→H→PANEL chain on ONE circuit (Great Britain) OFFLINE end-to-end green (not just fixture tests) and paste that run's console tail as evidence — the first full-chain run must NOT be the unattended g3 run. pyright-0 on the new module. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
